tip-generic: Close the pane and open the message again. If it keeps happening, quote the code below to your IT team.
tip-network: Check your connection and try again. If it keeps happening, quote the code below to your IT team.
tip-auth: Minerva could not sign you in. Try again, and if you are asked to sign in, complete the prompt.
tip-deployment: This is a problem with the Minerva installation rather than with you. Quote the code below to your IT team.
no-message-description: Open a message in Outlook to report it.
report-description: Tell us what is wrong with the message you have open.
report-suspicious-description: Something about this message looks off.
comment-placeholder: Anything that would help someone reading this later
confirmation-body: Minerva is processing the message. You can close this pane.
confirmation-suspicious-body: The mail is on its way to the security team.
confirmation-spam-body: Mail like it should stop reaching your inbox.
identified-system: Minerva already knows this mail. The security team is on it.
identified-simulation: This was a phishing test from your own organisation. Reporting it was the right thing to do.
identified-unknown: Minerva has not seen this mail before, so someone will take a look.
notified-failed: Could not reach {{address}} — the report was still filed
move-failed: The mail could not be moved. Your report was filed — you can move the mail yourself.
unsupported-generic: Minerva could not start in this window. Try opening the message in Outlook again.
unsupported-timeout: Minerva could not reach Outlook. Check your connection, then open the message again.
unsupported-host: Minerva reports email, so it only runs in Outlook.
unsupported-requirement-set: This version of Outlook is too old for Minerva. Update Outlook, or open the message in Outlook on the web.
